summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline featuring automated feature engineering, cross-validation, and model ensembling. However, it critically leaks test data by fitting TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoders on the concatenated train and test sets (FM09). Furthermore, the ensemble relies on hardcoded weights without optimization (FM12), and only accuracy is evaluated without considering class balance (FM15).
